label: defixs-finance.vercel.app
title: Defix-Finance | One-Stop DeFi Solution
reasons: The app bundle contains the field name 'seedPhrase' alongside the app's own copy 'Click here to rectify all strange wallet issues.' and 'Fixed WalletConnect issues' — a wallet-support pretext for collecting seed phrases.

The page's bundled copy includes 'CLAIM AIRDROP', 'ASSET RECOVERY' and 'MISSING/IRREGULAR BALANCE', and lists 'Trust Wallet', 'WalletConnect' and 'Coinbase Wallet', impersonating real wallet services to harvest credentials.
The served HTML is an empty root div, so all visible functionality is in the 359kb bundle; these strings are this page's own offer, not library internals.

label: rectifyesvalidation.vercel.app

Freshly deployed scam-style copy ('100% Gas Refunds', 'Restore your Account', 'Claim Airdrop') on a repo created 2026-08-16 presents a fake 'EVM Resolve' protocol whose only function is to connect a wallet and move funds.

label: syamilmuzaffar15-boop.github.io/Verifcation

label: maqsudbek4224-art.github.io/dadajonim-onajonim
title: Dadajonim va Onajonimga ❤️
reasons: On page load, the JavaScript sends a Telegram message via `https://api.telegram.org/bot${BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage?chat_id=${CHAT_ID}&text=${encodeURIComponent(text)}` with the visitor's device, browser, and geolocation, and requests location through `navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition` then posts a Google Maps link with exact latitude/longitude.
Visitors are not told their location and device data is being transmitted to a Telegram chat; the page presents itself only as a personal love letter to parents, with no disclosure or consent option.

The page also exfiltrates the user's typed text: `submitPersonalMsg()` sends `💌 Farzandingizdan shaxsiy xabar:

${val}` to the same Telegram API endpoint, and every button click in `notifyButtonClick` reports section names to the same chat.
